verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents tracing and debugging via LangSmith and local test servers (`langgraph dev`/`langgraph up`). None of it shows built-in evaluators that score agent quality, or a documented way to run evals in CI. Tracing and local dev environments are adjacent features, not an eval capability, and the axis is a fair question for an agent framework, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can score agent quality with built-in evals and run them as part of CI
